piles.label: Dark Leo & Shredder (deck 104)
piles.intro: Every pile card graded for the Orzhov Ninja deck. Cards in the deck show as in; the rest are the bench.

piles.label: Doesn't fit
piles.intro: Good cards for a different deck: the lifegain and aristocrats clusters, and cards that fight the Ninja count.

cards.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dean of Shadow

Ayli, Eternal Pilgrim.text: Deathtouch 2-drop and a sac outlet; the exile needs +10 life. ★ only in a lifegain build.

Feast of the Victorious Dead.text: Aristocrats payoff; competes with F1 (sacrificing Ninjas lowers the count).

Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim.text: Deathtouch 2-drop; life on every creature entering (Ninja tokens, sneak re-entries).

Hardened Tactician.text: Sacrifices tokens for cards — the commander's Ninja tokens are F1's count.

Karai's Technique.text: Sneak {W}{B}: ±3/±3, either or both, and it returns an unblocked attacker.

Karai, Future of the Foot.text: Ninja; combat damage returns a creature card — to the battlefield when sneaked.

Kaya, Geist Hunter.text: Team deathtouch (attacking Ninjas already have it), doubled tokens once.

Lurrus of the Dream-Den.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Lurrus of the Dream-Den.text: Recasts a ≤2 MV permanent from the graveyard each turn: the cheap Ninjas and enablers come back.

Oath of Kaya.text: 3 damage and 3 life on entry; punishes attacks on planeswalkers.

Ruthless Lawbringer.text: Enters → sacrifice a creature, destroy any nonland permanent; sneak returns re-buy it.

Baron Bertram Graywater.text: A lifelink Vampire when tokens enter, sac-draw; not Ninjas.

Elenda, Saint of Dusk.text: Lifegain payoff; ★ in a lifegain build.

Kaya the Inexorable.text: −3 exiles any nonland permanent; +1 protects a key creature.

Starseer Mentor.text: Flying vigilance 5-drop with an end-step punisher.

Vona, Butcher of Magan.text: Repeatable removal for 7 life; better with lifegain.

Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.text: Enters → destroy a nonland, nontoken permanent; menace; sneak re-buys it.

Mister Negative.text: 7-drop life swap and cards; situational at 25 life.

Moment of Reckoning.text: 7 mana, four modes of destroy or return.

Turncoat Kunoichi.text: Ninja; sneak 4 exiles a creature for good.

Leonardo, Cutting Edge.text: Ninja with Sneak {W}: the cheapest sneak in the pile; lifelink, grows on lifegain.

Quintessential Katana.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Quintessential Katana.text: Attaches itself to every Ninja that enters (sneaks included); untap plus 2 life per hit.

Lita, Little Orphan Amphibian.text: A 2-mana Ninja that grows, makes Food or scries on every creature entering.

Leonardo, Sewer Samurai.text: Ninja; double strike (two combat-damage triggers, F3); recasts power-1 creatures from the yard on your turn — Splinter, Hamato Yoshi, Super Shredder, Leonardo, Cutting Edge.

The Last Ronin's Technique.text: Sneak {1}{W}, instant: three Ninja Turtle Spirit tokens tapped and ATTACKING — three Ninjas at once.

Dokuchi Silencer.text: Ninjutsu {1}{B}; a hit discards a creature card (recursion fodder) to destroy a creature or planeswalker.

Splinter, the Mentor.text: Menace Ninja 2-drop; a Mutagen token whenever a nontoken creature leaves — every sneak return counts.

Super Shredder.text: Menace Ninja that grows whenever ANY permanent leaves (sneak returns, deaths, removal).

Undead Hand Ninja.text: Deathtouch Ninja 2-drop; drains whenever creature cards leave your yard (Karai, Lurrus, Leonardo).

Swarm Saboteur.text: Ninjutsu {B}, deathtouch; a hit conjures Virus Beetle (more hand attack).

Biting-Palm Ninja.text: Ninjutsu {2}{B}, menace; a hit exiles their best nonland card.

Ninja's Blades.text: Job select makes a Hero token and makes it a NINJA; loot plus life loss per hit.

Ninja Teen.text: Drain whenever a creature leaves (every sneak return); level 2 gives the team MENACE; level 3 sneaks creatures from the yard.

Shark Shredder, Killer Clone.text: Ninja; first strike; a hit steals a creature from their yard, attacking.

Shredder, Unrelenting.text: 6/4 deathtouch Ninja for Sneak {3}{B}; lends deathtouch.

Shredder, Shadow Master.text: Ninja; its OWN hit takes half their life — a second half-life source that needs no Ninja count (the copy clause is blank in 1v1).

Killian, Ink Duelist.text: Menace lifelink 2-drop; creature-targeting spells cost {2} less (Karai's Technique, removal, pumps).

Syr Vondam, Sunstar Exemplar.text: Menace vigilance 2-drop; grows on deaths and exiles (not on sneak returns).

Black Widow, Double Agent.text: A lone attacker gets first strike and menace — the one-attacker sneak setup; deathtouch.

Cloak and Dagger, Entwined.text: Deathtouch lifelink; enters → exile a card from hand or a creature; sneak returns re-buy it.

Indulging Patrician.text: Flying lifelink 1/4; ★ in a lifegain build.

Kambal, Profiteering Mayor.text: Drains 1 when your tokens enter (commander Ninjas, Last Ronin's Technique); copies their tokens.

Kambal, Consul of Allocation.text: Taxes their noncreature spells; a hate card.

Tymna the Weaver.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Tymna the Weaver.text: A card a turn after combat damage; in 1v1 that is pay 1, draw 1.

Kaya's Wrath.text: A sweeper in an attacking deck; emergency only.

Sorin, Solemn Visitor.text: Team +1/+0 lifelink, or a 2/2 flier (an enabler).

Silverquill, the Disputant.text: Flying 4/4; casualty copies Karai's Technique and the removal — but the sacrifice costs a Ninja.

Squall, SeeD Mercenary.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Squall, SeeD Mercenary.text: A lone attacker gets double strike (two hits, F3); a hit returns a ≤3 MV permanent.

Wispdrinker Vampire.text: Flier; drains on every small creature entering — most Ninjas, every sneak re-entry, every token.

Arvad the Cursed.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Arvad the Cursed.text: Legends +2/+2: 12 of the 17 Ninjas are legendary, plus the commander.

Closing Statement.text: Instant creature/planeswalker kill, cheaper at your end step.

Syr Vondam, the Lucent.text: Team deathtouch and +1/+0 on entry and attack; attacking Ninjas already have deathtouch.

Blot Out the Sky.text: X flying 2/1s: a wave of evasive attackers for sneaks; X ≥ 6 is a one-sided noncreature wipe.

Great Hall of Starnheim.text: Tapped, mono-B, sacrifice for an Angel.

Meticulous Commons.text: Untapped only with a planeswalker out.

White Widow, Yelena Belova.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
White Widow, Yelena Belova.text: Every deathtouch creature that connects grows — and attacking Ninjas all have deathtouch.

Black Widow, Deadly Hunter.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Black Widow, Deadly Hunter.text: A card per deathtouch creature that connects: under the commander, every Ninja hit draws.

The Cloning of Shredder.text: Three non-legendary token copies of one creature card from your yard — of a Ninja, that is three Ninjas.

Sally Pride, Lioness Leader.text: Mutant tokens per nontoken creature; not Ninjas.

Belladonna Took.text: Pays off tokens entering (commander's Ninjas, Last Ronin).

Leader's Talent.text: A counter on an attacker each attack.

Sheltered by Ghosts.text: 2-mana exile of any nonland permanent, plus lifelink and ward on your creature.

Enduring Innocence.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Enduring Innocence.text: A card a turn when small creatures enter — Ninjas, tokens and every sneak re-entry; returns once as an enchantment.

Gideon Blackblade.text: A 4/4 attacker on your turn; grants a keyword.

Practiced Offense.text: Team counters plus double strike; flashback.

Exemplar of Light.text: Flier; lifegain → counters → a card. ★ in a lifegain build.

Rosa, Resolute White Mage.text: A counter and lifelink each combat.

The Wandering Emperor.text: Flash; −2 exiles a tapped creature, +1 a counter and first strike, −1 a token.

Archangel of Thune.text: Lifegain engine; ★ in a lifegain build.

Bond of Discipline.text: Taps their whole board: every attacker unblocked, so every sneak is live — the five-Ninja finishing turn.

Captain America, Steve Rogers.text: Counter and indestructible on an attacker.

Boon-Bringer Valkyrie.text: Flier; backup hands a Ninja flying for the turn.

Exalted Sunborn.text: Token DOUBLER: two Ninjas per commander hit, six from Last Ronin's Technique; Warp {1}{W} for the big turn.

Inspiring Commander.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Inspiring Commander.text: A card for every small creature entering (tokens, sneak re-entries), no once-a-turn cap; 6 mana.

Righteous Fury.text: Kills tapped creatures — theirs after they attack.

Tymaret, Chosen from Death.text: Graveyard hate; fights Karai and Leonardo's recursion (G-42).

Black Market Connections.text: Card, Treasure or a CHANGELING token each turn — a changeling is a Ninja.

Madame Null, Power Broker.text: Counters for life on each creature entering.

Yathan Tombguard.text: Menace, and a card whenever a creature with a counter connects: White Widow puts a counter on every deathtouch attacker that hits, so the pair draws off each Ninja hit. Bench: Black Widow, Deadly Hunter already draws without needing counters.

Withering Curse.text: −2/−2 to all kills most of this deck's own Ninjas.

Barbed Servitor.text: Indestructible menace attacker that draws on a hit.

Doctor Doom, Unrivaled.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Doctor Doom, Unrivaled.text: A card a turn on a 4/4 lifelinker.

Eradicator Valkyrie.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Eradicator Valkyrie.text: Flying lifelink 4/3; boast edict (sacrifice a token, not a Ninja card).

Surgical Precision.text: Sorcery: kill toughness 4+, or a card.

Scourge of the Skyclaves.text: Kicked, both players lose half their life.

Finale of Eternity.text: X removal for up to three creatures.

Zero Point Ballad.text: Sweeper that kills the small Ninjas first.

Tataru Taru.text: A card, and a Treasure engine on their off-turn draws.

Smothering Tithe.text: Treasure off their draws; slow in 1v1.

Deadly Dispute.text: Sacrifice a token for two cards.

Grim Hireling.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Grim Hireling.text: Two Treasures per connecting combat; Treasures become removal.

Rev, Tithe Extractor.group: In: Combat-damage payoffs and card flow
Rev, Tithe Extractor.text: Deathtouch on attack; every connecting combat makes a Treasure and steals a card.

Revel in Riches.text: Treasure on their deaths; slow alternate win.

Vraska, Betrayal's Sting.text: Draw and proliferate; −2 neutralises a creature.

Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier.text: Flying lifelink 5/5; convoke for creatures; the back face gives the team persist. A good card that makes no Ninja.

Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dea.text: A 2-mana FLYING attacker — an unblocked enabler for sneaks; the back half is repeatable ping removal.

Vincent Valentine.text: Grows on their creatures dying (deathtouch blocks kill them); comes back once as the Beast.

My Precious.text: Equip → hexproof and can't be blocked: a guaranteed unblocked attacker for sneak every turn, or a protected commander. The Adventure half sacrifices a creature for two cards.
